Publisher fully hashes package sources/weights in16MiB blocks before load; this can populate file cache but does not prove a full anonymous CPU copy. Pinned Transformers usesmeta init outsideZeRO3, opens all safetensors shard mmap handles and holds lazy slices until completion. Tensor slices are materialized onCPU then moved toCUDA; normal BF16 destination tensors are installed into parameters. This is not a single-shard physical residency guarantee or proof that a second full CUDA clone is mandatory.

Current probe sets HF_ENABLE_PARALLEL_LOADING=false and HF_PARALLEL_LOADING_WORKERS=1, but selected5.17 loading code does not read these variables. New serial-loader experiments must explicitly declare the correct flag and separately measure effects; no reduced-peak claim follows from source alone.
